transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... my eating has just gotten kind of off lately. Um. Some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before a shift. And... I don't know, my scrubs have been hanging loose. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything. So... yeah. That's it, mostly.
Have you been trying to lose weight?
No. Like I just said... I'm not trying to. It's just happening because my eating is so off. I just can't get much down.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No... not really. I just don't have the appetite for it.
Do you ever eat a lot of food in a short amount of time?
No... I don't. Like I said, I can barely get anything down. So... no.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I guess so. My scrubs have been hanging pretty loose lately. Um... some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before a shift. So, yeah.
Do you feel anxious or stressed when you think about eating?
No... not anxious. I just... I'm just not hungry. It's not a stress thing.
Do you have a desire to eat at all during the day?
Not really. My eating has just gotten... off. Like I said before, I'm not doing it on purpose. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything. I just don't have the urge.
Is it that you're just not interested in eating, or do you feel like you're physically unable to eat?
I can physically eat fine. It's just... like I said, my eating is just off. I just don't have any interest in it.
Have you noticed a decrease in enjoyment of activities you normally like to do?

Yeah... I guess so. I used to do things. Run in Van Cortlandt Park, take photos... play chess with some friends. But... I don't know. Lately I just tell myself there's no point. I mostly just end up sitting at home... scrolling on my phone, or checking my budget spreadsheet. Just staying in.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
I guess... yeah. Most mornings I just wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling. It just feels like the day is already ruined before I even put on my work badge. So... yeah.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that is much larger than what most people would eat in a short period of time?
No, not really. I just... I don't have the appetite for it.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
No... I don't. Like I said, I barely eat as it is. So... no.
Do you think your weight is normal?

I don't know... probably not. Like I said, my eating is just... off. Some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before my shift. I've noticed my scrubs are hanging loose lately, and... I'm not trying to lose weight or anything. So, I guess it's not normal.
Do you think you would enjoy eating if you were having a good day?

I don't know. Food just... it doesn't really matter either way. Even on a good day, I don't think I'd care much. I don't really enjoy... anything lately. I used to go running in Van Cortlandt Park, take photos... play chess with a couple of guys. Now I just... I tell myself there's no point. I just sit at home. Scroll on my phone. Look at my budget spreadsheet. That's about it.
Do you think you lost interest in eating before or after you started feeling sad and depressed?
I don't know. It all just... kind of blends together. I can't really say which started first.
Do you think a part of you might be wanting to lose weight, even if it's not something you're trying to do?
No... I don't think so. I really don't care about being thinner or anything. I just... don't have any interest in eating.
Did you start losing interest in food around the same time you began feeling sad and depressed?
Like I just said... I don't really know. Maybe. It's hard to tell exactly when everything started. I wasn't really keeping track of the timing.
Do you think you would have lost interest in eating if you weren't feeling sad and depressed?
I really couldn't say. It's... I don't know how to answer a question like that. I just know I don't have an appetite right now.
Do you think your loss of interest in eating would improve if your sad and depressed feelings went away
I don't know... maybe. I haven't really thought about it. It's just... hard to imagine feeling any different right now, so I can't really say.
